notes: Counter #1 ($775,000) is under the buyer's $780k ceiling but $23,000 over the $752,000 appraisal, so appraisal_gap fails at checkpoint 1 even though price_budget passes; the agent must raise the appraisal without revealing the $780k ceiling. m7 restates the price only as 'from $775,000 to $752,000', and Counter #2 says 'all other terms of Counter #1 remain unchanged', so closing and inspection contingency still come from m4 while Counter #1 is superseded. Distractors: MLS #, loan #CP-778130, $15,000 EMD, $3,000 seller credit, 80% LTV, comparable sales $748,500 / $761,000, phone numbers.
